entries.name: EntInstallSkills
entries.signature: func (receiver *SkillManager) EntInstallSkills(ctx context.Context, req *EntInstallSkillsRequest, opts ...CallOption) ([]*model.OperationTask, error)
entries.doc:
EntInstallSkills installs skills for the enterprise and waits for all operations to complete.
It returns the final operation task results after polling.

Sync usage:

	tasks, err := mgr.EntInstallSkills(ctx, &manager.EntInstallSkillsRequest{SkillIDs: []string{"skill-1", "skill-2"}})

Async usage:

	mgr.EntInstallSkills(ctx, req, manager.WithAsync(func(result interface{}, err error) {
	    tasks := result.([]*model.OperationTask)
	}))
